citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility reported they did not complete the veterinary prescribed antibiotics for a urinary tract infection in a male adult
bobcat.
Failure to follow medical instructions puts an animals’ health and welfare at risk. Each dealer and exhibitor shall assure
that the attending veterinarian has appropriate authority to ensure the provision of adequate veterinary care and to
oversee the adequacy of other aspects of animal care and use.
Correct by 8/27/2026

citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
An adult female fox with a 2-month history of suspected deaffness had not had the symptoms reported to the attending
veterinarian at the time of the inspection August 27th, 2026. An appointment with the attending veterinarian August 31st
2026 revealed bilateral ear infections.
All animals must be observed on a daily basis, with any problems conveyed to the attending veterinarian in a timely
manner. Failure to consult with a veterinarian and provide appropriate diagnostics and treatment can result in a poor
outcome for animals. A mechanism of direct and frequent communication is required so that timely and accurate
information on problems of animal health, behavior, and well-being is conveyed to the attending veterinarian.
Correct by: 8/31/2026

The facility reported that a single Peregrine falcon suffered an injury to its toes while wearing its leather leggings in its
enclosure in April 27, 2026. She was taken for immediate treatment but the toe required partial amputation July 2026.
Enclosures must be constructed and maintained so that they protect the birds from injury. Corrected at the time of
inspection.
Correct by: 08/12/2024
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representative.
